# US onshore wind installations continue to increase despite Trump – American Clean Power Association

Wind power developers in the US commissioned 6.9GW of new onshore wind capacity during 2025, bringing the US’s total operational capacity to more than 161GW, according to the American Clean Power Association’s (ACP) annual report. 

 by Robyn White
